# LiteNetLib provenance

Source: https://github.com/RevenantX/LiteNetLib
Commit: ddacf9b7a3e821cc052e90c30daf82f0702a6db4
Library version: 2.1.4
License: MIT, retained in LICENSE.txt.

All library C# sources are copied unchanged. They compile into EGP.Networking
with LITENETLIB_UNSAFE and SIMULATE_NETWORK enabled. Simulation is disabled at
runtime unless explicitly configured by SessionOptions. Do not reference a
second LiteNetLib assembly in an EGP game.
